results.name: Valid starter retains two surveys, two addressed sites, nine facilities and one shared pump identity
Module composition uses six local tabs and no global rail, logo or app masthead
Actual r20 Intake tokens and embedded fonts are retained with no unresolved CSS variables
Register search clears an excluded selected survey and disables its local actions
Scope shows exact organisation, site, facilities and one installed/served-equipment relationship
Local tabs expose linked panels and keyboard focus traversal
Measured, observed, customer statement, assumption and unknown bases remain distinct
Observation inspector and Assistant share one modeless dock and exact fact context
Filtering out an inspected fact clears the panel and prevents hidden fact assistance
Changing measured basis shows the exact cleared fields and requires explicit review
Cancelled discard retains the unsaved basis proposal; confirmed discard preserves saved measurement
An unknown observation saves without a manufactured numeric value or unit
Submission refuses unowned uncertainty and shows the exact missing follow-up
Follow-up retains exact target, linked fact, responsible owner and due date
Scope changes cannot orphan observation, photo or follow-up references
Evidence view starts honestly empty and offers original-image capture
Photo capture rejects MIME-disguised text without retaining evidence
Validated upload retains exact original bytes, filename, target, caption, date and source
Photo metadata correction preserves original image bytes and before/after evidence
Submitting locks editing and captures an exact immutable review snapshot
Reviewer return preserves the submitted snapshot and records a specific reason
Returned-survey corrections retain earlier measurements and submitted source contents
Review with open information requires explicit acknowledgement of owned limitations
Reviewed revision remains exact and includes photos and owned open information
Prepared handover binds the exact reviewed revision, receiving team and owner without changing shared records
Successor revision starts a new draft while original review and prepared handover stay unchanged
Mutation guard rejects rewriting prior reviewed snapshots or prepared handovers
Retained-data validation rejects cross-site targets, malformed dates, duplicate references and missing original review
Changed-tab notification marks the Assistant stale and blocks regeneration and copy
Save compares the retained storage basis and refuses a competing generation while retaining the proposal
Reload preserves reviewed revisions, handover text, corrected facts and original photo bytes
Invalid backup is refused without replacing current survey state
Backup restoration previews counts and cancellation keeps current evidence
Confirmed backup restore loads a validated complete example with stable site identities
New survey creates independent identity and scopes facilities, contacts and equipment to its selected site
Read-only observer can inspect the module while all capture and review mutation actions are disabled
All rendered IDs are unique and native dialogs, frames and UI framework dependencies are not invented
Malformed retained storage stays preserved and is clearly separated from starter data
Storage failure retains the session change with truthful recovery messaging
No uncaught script errors in the exercised journeys

limits: Node/jsdom 27.0.1 DOM emulation. Native dialog/top-layer, menu layout, image decode (stubbed to a 1px fixture), browser/camera, clipboard, actual downloads, physical-device and independent acceptance remain unverified. No runtime, backend, operational or security acceptance is claimed.
